description: Reasons a person can pick after rating the agent. Call it once when the widget opens and cache it; re-read when the platform says the dictionary changed, or lazily by the `rev` value. Two lists: `reasons` are the live ones to draw in the window, `retired` are switched off and are only there so old feedback stays readable. 🔴 `label` is the best text WE have for the asked language and may fall back (`lang` says to what). `source_label` is what the admin actually WROTE and `source_lang` is the language they wrote it in — translate from THAT, never from `label`: translating our fallback would make a translation of a translation, losing a little at every step. When a card is shown untranslated, send `reason_shown_lang` with the rating so a reason picked blindly can be told from one picked on purpose. If this door is silent, show the free-text field anyway and still count the thumb — never drop a rating.

locale.description: Language of the person, e.g. ru / uk / de-AT. Falls back exact → base → English, never Russian.
